channel.title: Treasure Coast Today

item.title: E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks prompt 5 confirmed cases across Treasure Coast and Palm Beaches
item.description: Five local cases of cyclospora have been confirmed since May, with two in St. Lucie County, two in Palm Beach County and one in Martin County.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK flights in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: St. Lucie and Martin counties report cyclospora cases as residents avoid produce
item.description: St. Lucie County has two confirmed cases of cyclospora and Martin County has one confirmed case since May, according to the Florida Department of Health. Palm Beach County has two confirmed cases.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman wins $5 million from scratch-off bought in Fort Pierce
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, of St. Lucie County claimed a $5 million top prize from a scratch-off game on April 6. She purchased her winning ticket at a Fort Pierce store.

item.description:

item.description: A Leon County jury ordered Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe to pay $450,000 after finding him liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation. item.title: South Florida residents avoid lettuce, berries amid E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks
item.description: Thousands across the United States have been affected by contaminated produce outbreaks, with confirmed cases reported from Palm Beach County into the Treasure Coast.

item.title: Declassified intelligence reports show Chinese actor downloaded Florida voter data in 2022
item.description: President Donald Trump's Thursday address renewed debate over election security, while declassified records revealed publicly available Florida voter information was obtained by a foreign cyber actor.

item.title: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon gets September trial date in Capitol sit-in case
item.description: Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office, after the Aug. 18 primary.

item.title: Alex Vindman raises $8.5 million, expands lead in Florida Senate race fundraising
item.description: Vindman tightened his grip on the Democratic money lead during the second quarter, pushing his total receipts above $16 million as he challenges Republican Sen. Ashley Moody.

item.title: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces eligibility challenge in court
item.description: Next week will bring a court fight as Fishback defends his eligibility to remain in the primary over questions about Florida's seven-year residency requirement for governor.

item.title: Rep. Fabian Basabe says representing himself in court was a mistake after $450,000 verdict
item.description: Basabe told jurors he represented himself because he wanted to demonstrate that he had nothing to hide, but after the verdict acknowledged proceeding without an attorney was a mistake.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Fort Pierce woman wins $5 million on $20 scratch-off ticket
item.description:
Maria Duran, 57, of St. Lucie County claimed a $5 million top prize from the $5,000,000 CROSSWORD CASH scratch-off game on April 6, Florida Lottery officials announced Friday. Duran chose to receive her winnings as a one-time, lump-sum payment of $3,262,138.

item.description: A large waterspout passed over the Indian River Lagoon near Sebastian Friday afternoon as severe weather swept across the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County. item.title: Lightning strike suspected in Port St. Lucie house fire during Friday storms
item.description: Port St. Lucie fire crews responded to a house fire at the 900 block of Bellevue Avenue during Friday's severe weather as radar showed significant lightning activity.

item.title: Lightning strike ignites brush fire on Castinet Lane in Port St. Lucie
item.description: Lucie County Fire District crews contained a brush fire near the 1900 block of Castinet Lane after lightning ignited vegetation during Friday's storms.

item.title: Port St. Lucie records over 3 inches of rain as Friday storms bring high winds
item.description: Weather spotter Merry Moore O'Rourke reported over 3 inches of rain in Port St. Lucie as severe storms with high winds and heavy lightning moved through Friday.

item.title: Man airlifted to hospital after lightning strike in Okeechobee County
item.description: Fire rescue crews airlifted a man to the hospital after he was struck by lightning in Okeechobee County during Friday's severe weather.
